title: Krampus Worked for a Saint
jaTitle: クランプスは聖人のために働いていた
desc:
Krampus is often called a pagan spirit of winter, but in historical accounts he belongs to Christian Nicholas customs, in the service of the saint.

title: The Postcard That Made Krampus
jaTitle: クランプスの姿を作った絵はがき
desc:
Austria-Hungary introduced what is often called the first official postcard in 1869. Within decades, colorful cards gave Krampus his familiar look.
Full episode: https://youtu.be/hqYSHCpQNLw

title: Gold Through the Window? What the Golden Legend Says
jaTitle: 窓から金を？『黄金伝説』の本当の言葉
desc:
In a 1430s painting, Saint Nicholas throws gold through a window. In an old English translation of the Golden Legend, he throws it into a poor man's house at night, three times.
Full episode: https://youtu.be/hqYSHCpQNLw

Images
The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Open Access, CC0. Object nos.: 88.3.89, 65.97.5.
Title card: Quiet Origins. (quotation: The Golden Legend, trans. Caxton, ed. Ellis, 1900)
Narration: Kokoro / Heart (af_heart), synthetic speech.
Music: Suno.

#Shorts #History #Krampus
